7.11 Transmit buffering
This chapter only applies to CAN 2.0 and CAN FD. Using transmit buffering for CAN
XL within CanIf is not supported.
Note: In case the buffers provided by the hardware are not sufficient, the CAN XL
Driver might implement software buffers.
